floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. review.gallery: 7 Nshama design renders and 2 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. Selected photographs depict the structure under construction.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 8 and 6. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 3365 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 7 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. The printed totals differ from the displayed suite and balcony sums in several layouts, including 1 BR Type B and 2 BR Type A. The plan selector follows the printed totals.

unavailable: Verified visitor entrance, finished-building photos and current unit-specific measured areas.
